correctness.rationale: The unlooped third-shell operator expands in the characteristic-two group algebra as e1(1+e2), e2(1+e1), e1e2, or 1+e1+e2+e3 in the four dimension residues. Its square is the parity of C(n,3) times identity. The odd-dimensional rank of multiplication by e2 follows from the alternating form J+I, tensor differential, and field Künneth. The residue-two case reduces to this rank in n-1 variables; remaining rank cases use invertible unit and coordinate changes. Rank plus square-zero/involution gives exact Jordan type and all first-hit/cycle counts. Independent direct rank tests n=3..12, convolution-square checks, direct basis tests n=3..8, random states, and exhaustive n=3,4 orbit enumerations pass. Finite calculations are corroborative, not the proof.

value.rationale: The third Hamming relation is a canonical natural Cayley graph of an entire Hamming association scheme, with no arbitrary parameter slice. The proof determines complete dynamics for both loop choices and all dimensions in the doubly exponential configuration space. Dimension congruence produces a genuine reversal of nilpotent versus involutive evolution and the new quarter-dimension rank defect at n=2 mod4. This sharp classification is a meaningful structural invariant and not a finite test, a one-off table entry, or an asserted general theorem on all Hamming shells.
